rule: Every active CG owns an explicit camera role and every visible named actor owns a gaze target plus a supporting body action. Lens gaze is legal only for player_pov.

cg_start.story_action: The empty goshiwon asks the player to inhabit Minjun's absence before he appears.

cg_demo_first_interview.story_action: The interviewer reaches the six-year gap while Minjun decides whether the next sentence will be true.

actors.pose_support: Pupils and lowered chin turn screen-right; tense shoulders and closed hands hold the candidate side.
Pupils, glasses, chin, and resume hand turn screen-left toward him from the staff side.

cg_jiyeon_crash.story_action: The stopped sedan, complete bicycle, and open driver door form one readable accident chain.

actors.pose_support: Head and shoulders turn up-right toward her.
Eyes and chin turn down-left while she steps out from the driver side.

cg_demo_daeun_first_kindness.story_action: The counter separates staff and customer while the offered triangle rice package bridges them.

actors.pose_support: Eyes and smile rise screen-right while her offering hand crosses the counter.
Head and eyes angle down-left; his receiving hand remains near the package.

cg_demo_father_first_call.story_action: Separate rooms and inward-facing phones make distance visible without pretending they share a room.

actors.gaze_target: The implied caller through his handset
actors.pose_support: Head lowers toward the phone and the center divide.

actors.gaze_target: The implied caller through his handset
actors.pose_support: Head and phone angle inward toward the center divide.

cg_seollal_sebae_family.story_action: Minjun completes a formal Seollal bow in the same modest Changwon living room while Father's affection and the relatives' questions occupy the same frame.

actors.gaze_target: The floor and his stacked hands during the bow
actors.pose_support: Both knees stay grounded; both hands overlap directly before his lowered forehead in a formal Korean male sebae rather than a crawling pose.
Eyes, chin, and seated shoulders lower toward Minjun from the worn sofa.
Head and torso turn screen-left from the floor cushion toward him.
Back-view head and seated torso angle screen-left toward the bow without lens contact.

cg_jaehyuk_reveal.story_action: Documents and drink remain between Jaehyuk and Minjun as the reveal changes their relationship.

actors.pose_support: Face and torso stay oriented toward the foreground Minjun.
Back and shoulder line frame Jaehyuk rather than the lens.

cg_ending_father.story_action: Their joined hands carry the reconciliation while the hospital room stays secondary.

actors.pose_support: Head rests screen-right toward Minjun and their joined hands.
Head bows toward Father; both hands remain engaged.

cg_ending_gangnam_dream.story_action: Two figures share the Gangnam skyline instead of performing for the viewer.

actors.pose_support: Back-view posture faces the window.
Back-view posture parallels Minjun without lens contact.

cg_ending_empty_house.story_action: The empty apartment dominates while Minjun folds inward on the sofa.

actors.gaze_target: His hands and the unoccupied room
actors.pose_support: Head, shoulders, and seated torso collapse inward.

cg_ending_crypto_ghost.story_action: The phone and hostile monitor light trap Minjun inside the trading den.

actors.pose_support: Head, shoulders, and hands close around the device.

cg_romance_sea_daeun.story_action: Daeun turns back from the surf to share an unguarded laugh with Minjun.

actors.gaze_target: Minjun implied just left of the lens
actors.pose_support: Pupils, face, shoulders, and open smile turn camera-left together.

cg_romance_sea_jiyeon.story_action: Jiyeon lowers her sunglasses as her composure briefly opens under the parasol.

actors.pose_support: Pupils and chin angle down-left; the sunglasses hand opens the same line.
Cropped face and shoulder turn up-right toward her.

cg_romance_fireworks_daeun.story_action: Daeun watches the fireworks while Minjun watches her reaction.

actors.pose_support: Eyes, chin, and upper body lift toward the sky.
Foreground head and shoulder turn toward her profile.

cg_romance_fireworks_jiyeon.story_action: Jiyeon turns back after taking Minjun's hand, choosing him over the spectacle.

actors.pose_support: Eyes and face turn over her shoulder while her hand reaches back.
Foreground head follows her turn and joined hand.

cg_romance_cherry_daeun.story_action: Daeun looks into the blossom canopy while Minjun notices her delight.

actors.pose_support: Eyes, chin, and smile lift above camera-left.
Foreground head turns toward her.

cg_romance_cherry_jiyeon.story_action: Jiyeon interrupts her walk to look back at Minjun beneath the blossoms.

actors.pose_support: Pupils, face, and shoulder turn back toward him.
Foreground head and shoulder frame her return glance.

cg_romance_first_kiss_daeun.story_action: The near-kiss freezes before contact while both characters seek consent in each other's face.

actors.pose_support: Eyes and chin lift toward him while her hands keep hold of the cans.
Head and torso lean down toward her without lens contact.

cg_romance_first_kiss_jiyeon.story_action: The car-cabin near-kiss freezes before contact and centers mutual choice.

actors.pose_support: Pupils, chin, and shoulders turn toward him.
Pupils, chin, and shoulders turn toward her.

cg_romance_namsan_lock_daeun.story_action: Daeun asks whether they should add their own lock while the existing lock wall and summit tower structure keep the request physically grounded.

actors.pose_support: Pupils, chin, and shoulders turn screen-left toward him while her relaxed hand rests on the rail above the existing locks.
Pupils, face, and upper torso turn screen-right toward her; his hands stay withdrawn so her question owns the beat.

cg_romance_namsan_lock_jiyeon.story_action: Jiyeon dismisses the love locks with words but remains planted before them long enough for Minjun to notice.

actors.gaze_target: An existing padlock below her eye line
actors.pose_support: Lowered pupils and chin point to the lock wall while crossed arms and planted feet preserve her guarded contradiction.
Pupils, chin, and torso angle screen-left toward her rather than toward the camera or city.

cg_romance_amusement_lost_child_daeun.story_action: Daeun and Minjun walk a tearful lost child toward guest services after the parade, each adult holding one of the child's hands.

actors.pose_support: Pupils and chin lower screen-right while her inner right hand holds only the child's left hand; her outer hand remains in her jacket pocket.
Tearful eyes and lifted chin point screen-left toward Daeun while each hand remains separately held by one adult.

actors.gaze_target: The child between him and Daeun
actors.pose_support: Softened eyes, a small reassuring smile, lowered chin, and relaxed shoulders point screen-left; his inner left hand holds only the child's right hand.

cg_romance_amusement_photo_strip_jiyeon.story_action: The four booth frames move from composed posing through mutual eye contact and shared laughter to Jiyeon's surprise cheek kiss.

actors.gaze_target: Booth lens, then Minjun, then Minjun's cheek
actors.pose_support: Her pupils and chin follow the four-frame sequence while her wine jacket, seat position, and face identity remain fixed.
His expression changes from an awkward near-smile to reciprocal eye contact, genuine laughter, and natural surprise; his black date outfit and seat remain fixed.

cg_romance_narrow_room_jiyeon.story_action: Jiyeon calls Minjun's narrow room real while two cups of ramyeon make the room physically two people wide.

actors.gaze_target: Minjun across the narrow floor aisle
actors.pose_support: Pupils and chin turn screen-right while relaxed shoulders and arms around her knees hold the same line.
Pupils, face, and torso turn screen-left while his ramen-setting hand remains between them.

cg_romance_hometown_night_bus_daeun.story_action: The same window holds receding rural lights and approaching Seoul while Daeun finally sleeps and Minjun stops counting money for one night.

actors.pose_support: Closed eyes, relaxed jaw, lowered shoulders, and the weight of her head against the glass all support genuine sleep without leaning on Minjun.

actors.gaze_target: Daeun and the city lights reflected beyond her
actors.pose_support: Pupils and chin turn screen-left; a restrained peaceful smile and open shoulders replace his default defeated expression.

cg_romance_proposal_daeun.story_action: Only after Minjun takes out the box, the rainy cafe pulls back far enough to keep Daeun's reaction and the ring visible above the result text.

actors.pose_support: Tearful pupils and face turn screen-left toward him; her right hand covers her mouth with five clear fingers while her left hand rests beside the open box.
Back-view head and black-crewneck shoulders face screen-right toward her without lens contact.

cg_romance_wedding_daeun_small.story_action: After entering first, Minjun waits at the altar while Daeun walks from the rear doors toward him; the sparse screen-left groom side and full screen-right bride side make five years of social cost visible.

actors.gaze_target: Daeun approaching from the rear entrance
actors.pose_support: Back-view head and squared shoulders remain still at the altar and face her; his plain charcoal suit stays distinct from the seated guests.
Her short-haired adult face, pupils, and walking posture align toward him; both hands hold one small bouquet naturally at her waist.

cg_romance_wedding_daeun_full.story_action: The full package upgrades the hall, gown, veil, bouquet, and flowers while Minjun waits at the altar, but it cannot fill the sparse screen-left groom side.

actors.gaze_target: Daeun approaching from the rear entrance
actors.pose_support: Back-view head and squared shoulders remain still at the altar and face her while empty chairs stay visible at screen-left.
Her same short-haired adult face and pupils look toward him as she walks; both hands hold one bouquet against the refined satin A-line gown.

cg_romance_wedding_gap_jiyeon.story_action: A vast empty ballroom and unequal stacks of invitation cards turn the Han family's expected scale into visible pressure before Minjun chooses.

actors.gaze_target: Jiyeon and Minjun across the table
actors.pose_support: Three-quarter back head and navy-suited torso face the couple while one anatomically clear hand anchors the table edge.
Pupils and chin angle screen-left toward him; controlled shoulders and one pocketed hand keep tension inside the ivory planning suit.
Eyes and chin lower toward the three blank cards while his plain charcoal suit and closed shoulders register pressure without a lens-facing defeat pose.

cg_romance_first_snow_daeun.story_action: Outside the convenience store where they met, Daeun offers Minjun one of exactly two small canned coffees as the first snow falls.

actors.pose_support: Her pupils, face, and shoulders turn screen-left toward him while her right hand offers one small can and her left hand holds the second can close to her coat.
His pupils and chin turn screen-right toward her while one open hand reaches naturally toward the offered can without touching her fingers.

cg_romance_first_snow_jiyeon.story_action: With the left-hand-drive sedan stopped and the wipers resting, Jiyeon asks Minjun to remain inside while snow gathers on the windshield.

actors.gaze_target: Minjun in the front passenger seat
actors.pose_support: From the screen-left driver's seat, her pupils, face, and upper torso turn screen-right toward him while her seat belt and winter coat remain physically coherent.
From the screen-right passenger seat, his pupils, face, and upper torso turn screen-left toward her while his seat belt and quilted winter jacket remain coherent.

cg_romance_wedding_morning_daeun.story_action: On their first married morning, Daeun cooks a rolled omelet in the half-unpacked kitchen while Minjun watches from the bedroom doorway.

actors.gaze_target: The rolled omelet in the pan
actors.pose_support: Her profile and lowered eyes follow the pan; her left hand grips its handle while her right hand holds the wooden spatula above the omelet.

cg_romance_wedding_morning_jiyeon.story_action: Bare-faced on their first married morning, Jiyeon meets Minjun's gaze and hides her embarrassment behind the duvet.

actors.pose_support: Her pupils and face meet the player POV while one visible hand pulls the duvet to her nose and the other remains hidden.

cg_romance_breakup_daeun.story_action: After learning how Minjun used her trust, Daeun quietly presses one seal onto the separation paper between them.

actors.pose_support: Her composed face stays lifted toward him while her right hand presses the single red seal and her left hand lies flat on the blank paper edge.

actors.gaze_target: Daeun and the paper between them
actors.pose_support: His rear three-quarter head and collapsed white-shirt shoulders face her; he remains withdrawn on his side of the table and does not reach for her or the document.

cg_romance_breakup_jiyeon.story_action: Jiyeon crosses the apartment threshold toward her own world while Minjun accepts the distance and stays behind.

actors.pose_support: Her straight shoulders, forward step, relaxed free hand, and handbag hand all continue through the threshold without a backward or lens-facing appeal.
He remains seated by the room and window with his torso and head turned toward her while both arms stay lowered and never reach.

cg_ending_full_circle.story_action: In the newly occupied Gangnam room, Minjun tells Father by phone that Sangchul's debt is finally gone.

actors.gaze_target: The ordinary daylight beyond the phone call
actors.pose_support: The phone stays at his ear while wet eyes, lowered shoulders, and a quiet three-quarter profile carry relief without looking into the lens.

cg_ending_gangnam_dream_white.story_action: Minjun holds the blank deed folder in clear morning light and recognizes the person who reached Gangnam without crossing the line.

actors.pose_support: His body remains open to the city while the cream folder rests at his side and his turned face meets the reflection rather than the camera.

cg_ending_with_daeun.story_action: Two cooling bowls of ramyeon make the modest outer-Seoul home a shared destination rather than a failed one.

actors.pose_support: Her eyes, small smile, raised chopsticks, and near-touching free hand all turn screen-right toward him.
His face and shoulders turn screen-left while his relaxed hand remains beside hers between the two bowls.

cg_ending_second_love.story_action: Daeun asks what comes next at the Gangnam window while Minjun answers by making a second cup of coffee.

actors.pose_support: She turns over her shoulder from the window with one mug held low, keeping the night view and his action on one axis.
His eyes turn screen-left toward her while both hands continue the coherent pour-over action above the second mug.

cg_ending_jiyeon_man.story_action: Jiyeon joins Minjun at the mirror; the camera sees each actor exactly once inside the reflection so the pair can read as intimacy or self-erasure without inventing a second pose.

actors.gaze_target: His own eyes in the mirror
actors.pose_support: He appears only once, screen-left inside the mirror, with level shoulders, an upright square torso, and both hands below the vanity crop; his restrained expression avoids lens contact.

actors.gaze_target: Minjun's face inside the same reflection
actors.pose_support: She appears only once, screen-right inside the mirror, with level shoulders, an upright square torso, and both hands below the vanity crop; her eyes turn toward Minjun rather than the lens.

cg_ending_guardian.story_action: Father and Minjun leave the modest Changwon hospital together after the second life Minjun chose to protect.

actors.pose_support: His tired face and torso turn screen-right toward his son while his stride remains independent and alive.
His head turns screen-left while one hand carries the single duffel and the other arm holds Father's folded jacket.

cg_ending_jaehyuk_way.story_action: Alone in the Gangnam apartment, Minjun rests one hand on the half-drawn curtain between the city he bought and the room he emptied.

actors.gaze_target: The remaining strip of city beyond the curtain
actors.pose_support: His back dominates the frame while one clear hand stops on the curtain and a narrow profile avoids both triumph and lens contact.

cg_ending_sangchul_reckoning.story_action: After the call to Father, Minjun lowers the phone beside blank papers and lets the open window turn Gangnam back into ordinary sky.

actors.pose_support: The lowered phone, still writing hand beside the pen, released shoulders, and side profile all point away from the lens toward the open window.

cg_ending_late_call.story_action: On the KTX bound for Changwon, Minjun removes an earbud and presses the phone closer after Father promises him an ordinary bowl of gukbap.

actors.gaze_target: Rain moving down the train window
actors.pose_support: His right hand holds one phone to his ear while his raised left hand holds one removed earbud; released shoulders and damp restrained eyes turn toward the glass rather than the lens.

cg_ending_lonely_rich.story_action: After one single-person delivery arrives, Minjun sits at one end of a four-seat Gangnam table and finally sees the three empty chairs his balance cannot fill.

actors.pose_support: He stays upright but drained; one hand rests beside the single delivery bag while the other has placed one phone face-down, keeping his attention off the screen, food, skyline, and lens.

cg_ending_gambling_recovery.story_action: At the five-year close, Minjun adds today's circle to the wall calendar in the same small room where recovery began.

actors.gaze_target: The circle closing beneath his pen
actors.pose_support: His clear right hand holds one pen against the calendar while his open left hand rests beside one face-down phone; released shoulders and a quiet profile avoid both triumph and lens contact.

cg_ending_bankruptcy.story_action: At the first bankruptcy threshold, Minjun stops re-entering the same impossible calculation while the collection phone falls silent beside him.

actors.gaze_target: The calculator beneath his stopped right hand
actors.pose_support: He remains upright but drained; his right fingers stop beside one calculator while his left hand rests near the face-down phone, holding shock inward without collapsing or facing the lens.

cg_ending_debt_spiral.story_action: Below the deeper debt threshold, Minjun turns the calculator face-down, releases it, and leaves the collection phone unanswered.

actors.gaze_target: The face-down calculator beyond his released right hand
actors.pose_support: He sits lower but remains upright; his open right hand has stopped short of the calculator while his left hand hangs beside one knee, carrying hollow stillness without self-harm staging or lens contact.

cg_ending_startup_exit.story_action: Immediately after signing the acquisition agreement, Minjun releases the pen and lets his shoulders fall before addressing the team.

actors.gaze_target: The signature line nearest his hands
actors.pose_support: His lowered eyes, released right hand beside the pen, open left hand beside the correctly oriented phone, and easing shoulders hold relief inward without a victory pose or lens contact.

cg_ending_instant_legend.story_action: Before his first year is over, 33-year-old Minjun enters the nearly empty Gangnam apartment and discovers that the goal has arrived before the rest of his life.

actors.gaze_target: The blank deed folder held at mid-torso
actors.pose_support: His young face and slim shoulders remain upright but stalled; the left hand holds the folder's left edge while the right loosely supports its lower-right edge, without a victory pose or lens contact.
